start.title: Find the pinned comment on a YouTube video

args.text: The comments under a video are where its creator often adds context. On this one, the zoo where it was filmed has left a comment of its own.

args.instruction: A pinned comment always comes first, above everything the sort order decides.

args.text: Everything below it depends on how the list is sorted.

args.instruction: Choose the order here: the top comments, or the newest first.

args.text: Top comments are the ones YouTube picks out. Newest first shows the conversation as it happens.

finish.openingSubtitle: YouTube · the comments under a video
finish.closingText: Pinned first, then the order you choose.
